---
title: "About"
---

I read database source code and write about what I find.

Right now that's mostly PostgreSQL and ClickHouse. I'm trying to explore more OLAP databases going forward. Typically, I put a video on my [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@TheWALStreetJournal), for each blog post.

## Get new posts by email

One email when a new post or video is out. Nothing else.

```{=html}
<form action="https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/thewalstreetjournal"
      method="post" target="popupwindow"
      onsubmit="window.open('https://buttondown.com/thewalstreetjournal', 'popupwindow')"
      class="embeddable-buttondown-form">
  <div class="input-group" style="max-width: 420px;">
    <input type="email" name="email" class="form-control"
           placeholder="you@example.com" aria-label="Email address" required>
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Subscribe</button>
  </div>
</form>
```
